senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נגף)to bring in close contact; to knock, strike against, wound.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 7b:15">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>אין אדם נוֹקֵף וכ׳</he> no one on earth bruises his finger, unless it is decreed &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 7b">Ber. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 6b:6">Meg. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שלבו נוֹקְפוֹ</he> he whom his heart smites (who has no clear conscience).
<cite ref="Niddah 3b">Nidd. 3ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>לבו נוקפו ופורש</he> he may have scruples and separate himself entirely from his wife.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01237"><he>נֶקֶף</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:15">Maas. Sh. V, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:10">Sot. IX, 10</cite> <he>הנוֹקְפִים</he> those who knocked the sacrifices on their heads; expl.
<cite ref="Sotah 48a">ib. 48ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. IX, 24ᵃ bot.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N01183"><he>נָקוּף</he></cite>; f. <he>נְקוּפָה</he>; pl. <he>נְקוּפִים</he>, <he>נְקוּפִין</he>; <he>נְקוּפוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:24">Tosef. Ḥull. III, 24</cite> <he>ביצים נ׳ לקערה</he> eggs cracked open into a dish (<cite ref="Chullin 64a:4">Ḥull. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>טרופות</he>).

<cite ref="Sotah 22b:3">Sot. 22ᵇ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="N01239"><he>נקפי</he></cite>) <he>המַנְקִיף את רגליו</he> he who knocks his feet against each other (by his mincing walk; Rashi: who causes his feet to strike against objects on the road); cmp. <cite ref="N01251"><he>נָקַשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 10:7">Nidd. X, 7</cite> <he>ומַקֶּפֶת</he> and brings the vessel which contains the Ḥallah near the dough; <cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 4:3">T’bul Yom IV, 3</cite>, sq.

Bets. IV, 5 ואין מַקִּיפִין שתי וכ׳ and you must not move two wine vessels together to put upon them &c.—Esp. (ritual law, in examining an organic defect found in a slaughtered animal) to create a defect similar and near to the one found, in order to ascertain whether the latter was not the result of an accident after slaughtering; in gen. to compare.

<cite ref="Chullin 50a:13">Ḥull. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>מַקִּיפִים בבני מעים</he> we may compare defects in entrails in which was found a perforation the origin of which is doubtful by making a hole next to it.
<cite ref="Chullin 50a:16">Ib.</cite> <he>מקיפין בקנה</he> we may compare defects in windpipes; a. fr.—
Kidd. 40ᵃ אין מקיפין בחילול השם no comparing (balancing of sins against good deeds) is granted when the Name of God is profaned; (oth. interpret., v. נָקַף II).—Part. pass. מוּקָּף brought near.

<cite ref="Eruvin 30b">Erub. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 7a">Ḥull. 7ᵃ</cite>; a. fr. <he>לתרום שלא מן המ׳</he> to take T’rumah out of a mass which is not in close neighborhood of those products which are to be redeemed; <cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 2:5">Bicc. II, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 4:3">Ter. IV, 3</cite>; a. e.
